v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Christus resúrgens ex mórtuis iam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur. Quod enim mórtuus est peccáto, mórtuus est semel: quod autem vivit, vivit Deo.
text.en: Knowing that Christ rising again from the dead, dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him. For in that he died to sin, he died once; but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

r.en: Let heaven and earth rejoice, alleluia.

text.la: Ardens est cor meum, * desídero vidére Dóminum meum: quæro, et non invénio, ubi posuérunt eum, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Mine heart is on fire: * I would that I might see my Lord: I seek Him, and know not where they have laid Him. Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd I post Octavam Paschæ
